definitions.explanation: Able to withstand wear, pressure, or damage; not easily broken.
Having good health, not prone to illness.

notes:
{丈夫|じょうぶ} is a na-adjective meaning sturdy (for objects) or healthy (for people/bodies).

FORMS:
- Attributive: {丈夫|じょうぶ}⟦な→な：09497_na⟧ + noun
- Predicate: {丈夫|じょうぶ}⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧/⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧
- Adverbial: {丈夫|じょうぶ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ ({丈夫|じょうぶ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{育|そだ}つ→育つ：01951_sodatsu⟧ — to grow up healthy)

SENSE 1 — STURDY/DURABLE (objects):
- {丈夫|じょうぶ}⟦な→な：09497_na⟧⟦{靴|くつ}→靴：00725_kutsu⟧: sturdy shoes
- {丈夫|じょうぶ}⟦な→な：09497_na⟧⟦{素材|そざい}→素材：09492_sozai⟧: durable material
- {丈夫|じょうぶ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{作|つく}る→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧: to build solidly

SENSE 2 — HEALTHY/ROBUST (people, bodies):
- ⟦{体|からだ}→体：00784_karada⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{丈夫|じょうぶ}: to be physically healthy
- ⟦{胃|い}→胃：01706_i⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{丈夫|じょうぶ}: to have a strong stomach
- {丈夫|じょうぶ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{育|そだ}つ→育つ：01951_sodatsu⟧: to grow up healthy

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{大丈夫|だいじょうぶ}→大丈夫：00772_daijoubu⟧: all right, okay (related but different meaning)
- ⟦{頑丈|がんじょう}→頑丈：08639_ganjou⟧: sturdy, solid (stronger emphasis on toughness)
- ⟦{健康|けんこう}→健康：02706_kenkou⟧: healthy (more clinical/general)
